episodes.title: Your Brighter Tomorrow, Today
episodes.summary: Take it from Jack Billings: The life you've always wanted is just one great deal away.

episodes.title: Great Salesmen Make Their Own Turf
episodes.summary: Believe it or not, 99% of sales are decided on first impressions. So look sharp, know your stuff, and don't let the pressure get to you.

episodes.title: A Traveling Salesman Travels
episodes.summary: Funny how doing what's best for those we love sometimes means saying goodbye to them.

episodes.title: Forms, Appropriately Filled and Filed
episodes.summary: To really be there for a member of your team, you have to be ready to put it all on the line -- anytime, no questions asked.

episodes.title: From the Desk of Stanley Jenkins
episodes.summary: A new market provides the perfect chance to redefine what people think about your product, your company, and you.

episodes.title: The Numbers Behind the Numbers
episodes.summary: Turning the greatest setback of your career into your greatest opportunity is the mark of a true winner.

episodes.title: Another Day, Another Apocalypse
episodes.summary: When a customer gets cold feet (and they all do), what they're really saying is: How much do you care?

episodes.title: The Gargon Mothership
episodes.summary: Any salesperson worth their salt always remembers the brave heroes who made peace, prosperity, and great products possible.

episodes.title: Certain Forces Once Unleashed
episodes.summary: Your product can take on a life of its own with the right pitch, crowd, and moment. Then you just buckle up and enjoy the ride—and profits.

episodes.title: What Could Be Better?
episodes.summary: Season finale. You can't give your customers everything, but you can make them believe that what you're giving them is all they'll ever need.
